sec12.note: * As the product has evolved, its name has changed, and old and new packaging will ship side by side for a while. Some boxes still carry the name “MixPad Elf Smart Voice Switch”, but every unit is a genuine ORVIBO product, so you can buy with confidence.

sec5.title: Swap a switch, make every light voice-controlled
sec5.desc: Enjoy voice-controlled lighting without changing a single bulb. Before you head out, one sentence turns off every light in the house.
sec5.voice.alarm: Butler, set an alarm for 6:30 tomorrow morning.
sec5.voice.weather: Butler, what's the weather like today?
sec5.voice.studyLight: Study light off, bedroom light on.
sec5.voice.car: I'm leaving at 8, book me a car.
sec5.voice.acTemp: Hi Butler, turn on the living room AC and set it to 20°.
sec5.voice.nap: Start nap mode and wake me in an hour.
sec5.voice.cleaning: Butler, start cleaning mode in the kitchen.
sec5.voice.lightsWindow: Butler, lights off. Close the window.
sec5.voice.music: Hi Butler, play some relaxing music.
sec5.voice.date: What's the date and day today?
